about_page_description: Game audio designer with a background in music, maths, physics, and technical implementation across game engines and immersive training.
hook: I build game audio from both sides: creative and technical.
intro_sub: Belgium · DAE Howest · Technical sound design · XR Labs
story_1: Gaming was my first passion, and over time it turned into a real drive to learn game development. Before that, I was already deeply into making music, which is what naturally pulled me toward audio in games.
story_2: My background in maths and physics gave me a strong instinct for technical learning. That pushed me toward programming, systems thinking, and the more exact side of solving creative problems.
story_3: Three years at DAE in Kortrijk, one of the strongest game development schools in Europe, gave me a foundation in C++, C#, audio implementation in Unity and Unreal, and everyday work with middleware.
background_1: Hi, I'm Igor. Games were the thing that pulled me in first, but after a while I wanted more than just playing them. I wanted to understand how games are built, why they work, and how all the different parts come together.
background_2: Before I got serious about game development, I was already deep into music. That is what naturally pushed me toward game audio, while maths and physics gave me the mindset to enjoy the technical side of implementation too.
background_3: At DAE in Kortrijk I spent three years learning C++, C#, Unity, Unreal, middleware, and collaborative production. The projects there made me realize I did not just want to study this stuff. I wanted to build, ship, and keep getting better at it.
approach_1: Right now I am working at XR Labs as a lead technical sound designer. I design sounds, implement them, and keep iterating until they actually feel right in the context of the project.
approach_2: What I like most is that the work is real and immediate. I get to work on training simulations for police, military, and customs units, then see those scenarios tested and hear direct feedback on what helps realism and what does not.
approach_3: That is why I care so much about both sound quality and believable acoustics. A lot of that work goes into Steam Audio reflections, transmission, material absorption, and the small details that make a VR or AR simulation feel convincing.
cta_text: Game audio, technical sound design, implementation, tools, or immersive audio work. If you have a project, I'm happy to talk.
